group.title: Checking the roof
group.passage:
F1: Thanks for coming. A stain appeared above our reception desk after last night's rain. We're opening another office next month, so a new roof would be hard to afford.
M1: I'll check the roof first. Fallen leaves can stop rainwater from flowing off a roof that is otherwise fine.
F1: The building manager saw a pile of wet leaves on the roof. Can you get upstairs while our clients arrive?
M1: I'll use the stairs at the back, away from the lobby. If we clear the blockage, you may not need a new roof.
F1: That's a relief. Please take photos of anything you find, so I can show the manager why the work was needed.
group.passageZh:
F1：謝謝你趕來。昨晚下雨後，我們接待桌上方出現了污漬。下個月還要開另一處辦公室，換新屋頂恐怕負擔不起。
M1：我會先檢查屋頂。即使屋頂本身沒問題，落葉仍可能堵住雨水流出的路。
F1：大樓管理員看到屋頂上有一堆濕落葉。客戶陸續抵達時，你可以上樓嗎？
M1：我會走後面的樓梯，避開大廳。如果把堵塞清掉，你可能就不用換屋頂。
F1：那我就放心了。你發現什麼都請拍照，我好向管理員說明為什麼有必要施工。

Thanks for coming. A stain appeared above our reception desk after last night's rain. We're opening another office next month, so a new roof would be hard to afford.

I'll use the stairs at the back, away from the lobby. If we clear the blockage, you may not need a new roof.
That's a relief. Please take photos of anything you find, so I can show the manager why the work was needed.
